decision: Run a third full 240-cell runtime sweep, alone.
why: Attempt 1 stopped on a pre-existing harness crash (Collection list composed without a filter control); fixed in the proof harness, no generated output edited.
Attempt 2 stopped on typed gaps caused by concurrent package rebuilds from the mcp-server suite's packing specs; the gaps describe the scheduling, not the components.
rule: Nothing that rebuilds or packs a package (viz:gate, build:packages, the mcp-server suite, the sheet builders, the theme proofs) runs while the sweep runs.
